user.title: OPCOM PZU
user.description:
Prices come straight from OPCOM; no account or key is needed.

**Price history:** every past day is one request to OPCOM, sent one per second so the server is not overloaded. 12 months take about 10 minutes, the full archive (since 2015) over an hour. It runs in the background and you can use Home Assistant meanwhile. Follow the progress in the **Logbook**, or on the *History download progress* sensor. Set 0 to skip history.

data_description.currency: RON uses OPCOM's lei prices, EUR its euro prices. This cannot be changed later.
data_description.history_months: How far back to import prices for graphs (0 = none). You can change this later.
